queue.title: Officer queues
queue.mixed_queue_title: This queue holds two different things
queue.mixed_queue_body: Document holds carry forensic signals. Adjudication holds carry none: a late disqualifying verdict put them here, and there is no document to look at.
queue.document_hint: Documents the analyser could not clear. The forensic signal is a prompt to look, never a decision.
queue.adjudication_hint: Applications held after a late disqualifying verdict. They carry no document signal.
queue.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} records. Narrow the list from Applications to see the rest.

signal.no_document_evidence: No document evidence on this hold

decision.retry: Retry: the age verdict has not landed yet
decision.no_change: Already in that state. Nothing to change.

confirm.clearBody: This returns the application to the autonomous processing lane.
confirm.rejectBody: This records a rejection. Continue only when the grounds have been reviewed.
confirm.shortlistBody: This records the final decision as SHORTLIST.
confirm.acceptBody: Acceptance is final and may withdraw the applicant's other in-flight applications.

errors.refused: The action was refused: {{code}}. Nothing was changed.

bulk.confirmBody: This applies the decision to {{count}} records awaiting a final decision.
bulk.oneByOne: Records are decided one at a time; each has its own result and a refusal does not stop the rest.
